passages.note: Finchem is listed as prime sponsor of SB1057, a ballot-paper antifraud vendor-certification bill unrelated to voter identification.
Finchem voted Y on SB1057's Senate Third Reading, a single-subject ballot-paper antifraud bill, not a voter-identification measure.

passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding any other statute, any vendor that provides fraud countermeasures that are contained in and on the paper used for ballots shall be ISO 27001 certified, ISO 17025 certified or ISO 9001:2015 certified.
passages.note: The added section sets vendor certification and anti-counterfeiting standards for the physical ballot paper, not rules for verifying a voter's identity.

rows.reasoning: All three SB1057 passages (sponsorship, vote, and bill text) concern antifraud security features for ballot paper itself (watermarks, holograms, vendor ISO certification), not how the government verifies a voter's identity or eligibility. Per the annex's 'Ballots, not voters' rule, this is adjacent and establishes no rung.
